subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Sony Pictures Hack
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Sony Pictures Hack.

hook.text: North Korea hacked Sony Pictures over a comedy movie. They leaked emails, salaries, and unreleased films.

buildup.text: The 2014 attack destroyed Sony's internal network and exposed embarrassing executive communications.

discovery.text: The hackers demanded Sony cancel 'The Interview,' a comedy about assassinating Kim Jong-un.

twist.text: Sony initially pulled the film. The US government attributed the attack to North Korea publicly.

climax.text: A nation-state launched a destructive cyberattack over a movie. The rules of conflict had changed.

punchline.text: A comedy triggered a cyberwar. Reality beats fiction.

quiz.question: Why did North Korea attack Sony Pictures?
options: Over a comedy movie about their leader
